title: TopicCardVersion
description: F5-C Evolving Topic Summaries: append-only audit-log row. One row per successful re-summarize captures the *previous* summary + scopes plus the LLM metadata that produced the *new* summary on the topic_cards row. Initial topicization (version_no = 1) is NOT materialised here.

version_no.description: Per-topic monotonic version number. UNIQUE(topic_id, version_no).

summary.description: Snapshot of the previous TopicCard.summary just before commit_resummary.

supporting_items_count_at_time.description: TopicBundle.items count at the moment of re-summarize.

llm_provider.description: openai | anthropic | gemini | ollama (provider that produced the new summary).

created_at.description: When the version row was inserted (DB-side NOW()).
